summary: City of Grayville recreation page, Google Maps and Esri imagery read. $20 fee, 15 sites, water at every site, showers and dump station confirmed (manual); fee note cleared because it repeated the fields. Note cleaned of the unsupported 'some with sewer' and 'year-round; mix of overnight and seasonal campers'. Not waterfront kept. Pin OK. Season and booking not published.
flags: LOCAL: run by the City of Grayville (City Hall 618-375-3671); no price gate. RV rate $20/night, 15 water/electric sites, dump station, showers. Booking: page says only 'For more information contact Grayville City Hall'; no reservation statement, so booking left unset.

SEASONAL CHECK: the city page has no seasonal/monthly wording or rate. The old note's 'mix of overnight and seasonal campers' has no source on the page and was removed. Imagery (leaf-on, fall) shows no RVs that can be counted, so the nightly share could not be measured. Google 4.2 stars, 10 reviews. No discouraging wording found; not a drop candidate.
SEWER: the old note's 'some with sewer' is not on the page (it names only a dump station); sewer left unknown, the claim removed from the note.
SEASON: stored year_round (derived from note prose) is not stated on the page; left as stored, reviewer may clear.
RATE: web-search snippets (RV LIFE $15, a 2021 review citing a $15 sign) are lower than the city's posted $20; the city page is the authority, $20 kept.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront KEPT. The park sits on a hill above a levee and a wide floodplain field; the Wabash channel is beyond the field, well over 50 m.

PIN: OK. Stored 38.25100,-87.98600 is in the open area NE of the park road and buildings in Grayville Memorial Park. Google's 'Hilltop Campgrounds' point (38.24748,-87.98650, ~390 m S) falls in woods on an Industrial Row Dr address geocode and is not a camping point; not moved.
